Decals & Lettering – Apex Construction

Apex Consulting and Management is a renowned construction company with satisfied customers. They wanted to expand their clientele and increase their brand visibility. They came to Vinyl Wrap Toronto for solutions and our team suggested that fleet decals are one of the best ways of advertising. Decals can brand your company truck and turn it into a moving billboard. A branded car can attract customers and bring deals even when you are out to pick up lunch.

Apex Construction liked the idea of casually multiplying their current client size and our graphic designers got to work. Together we picked a vibrant blue for their company logo. The logo was placed and installed strategically on the back and sides of their F-Series pickup truck alongside their contact information in white vinyl. These vibrant vinyl colours worked well together and shined when they were installed on black background.

When it comes to their white Ford F-Series pickup truck, our graphic designers opted for decals in darker colours. Contrasting the bright white background, we chose black and deep blue for their brand logo and contact information display. Check our gallery above for this fleet wrap project!

In total, two company pickups were back in business in less than four business days. This quick turnaround limited the downtime in the schedules and guaranteed customer satisfaction.

Like Apex Construction, if you own a business, and want to increase your brand visibility and the size of your clientele by simply driving around in the city, Vinyl Wrap Toronto is the one-stop shop for you.

To check out our previous projects and get inspired for your next car wrap, go to our Portfolio.

Get a Free Quote by filling out the form and our team will get back to you as soon as possible.

You can also visit us at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4 or call us at 416-746-1381 to get an estimated truck wrap cost.

Don’t forget to follow us on Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, and Pinterest to hear about our special deals, creative wrap projects, and vehicle branding.
